10.14pm So Bangladesh have done what they set out to do, they've beaten Afghanistan 
by such a margin that their NRR is strong enough that they won't end in last position 
regardless of the outcome of the SL-Afghan game, and thus have qualified for the 
Super 4s! 
This was a win built on the shoulders of Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mehidy Hasan 
Miraz, whose centuries laid the platform for their massive total. Then with the ball, the 
bowlers kept things tight, especially the spinners through the middle overs, before a 
flurry of wickets at the death owing to scoreboard pressure sealed Afghanistan's fate. 
What this means for Afghanistan is that they will require a big win against Sri Lanka in 
Lahore on Tuesday if they're to qualify to the next round. 
Getting a few questions regarding the qualification criteria, let me try and explain it as 
best as I can. Essentially, if SL lose tomorrow by a small margin they may remain above 
Bangladesh but Afghanistan can't go above Bangladesh. If Afghanistan win heavy to 
qualify, they may end up going above Bangladesh's NRR but they will impact SL's NRR 
so heavily that it will go below Bangladesh's. Basically, there is no scenario where BOTH 
Afghanistan and SL can end on a high NRR than Bangladesh. 
Alright then, time now for the post-match presentation. 
Catch of the Match goes to Mushfiqur Rahim 
Mehidy Hasan Miraz gets an award for the most sixes. He is also named Player of the

wicket, the ball was coming on easy so I just tried to strike through the line. It was an 
excellent partnership with Shanto."

overs and come and bat, so we were really lucky to win the toss. [Mehidy promotion] He 
got his chance up the order and proved himself, we always knew he had the ability. We 
executed our plans really well, the fast bowlers especially bowled their heart out. This 
wasn't an easy wicket to bowl on."
